_finding: The outside review (21.11) read the paid passes as unproven: nothing on the site showed a pass had ever been sold. The count and the latest sale are read from Base, not kept by us: the settlement wallet's own transaction count, and its latest transaction found by a search over blocks, with who paid it. A purchase of our own must never read as a customer's.

mutations.name: the search takes the transaction at the count, not the one just below it
mutations.expect: FAIL the latest settlement is the wallet's transaction in the block where the count reached it, with its day

mutations.name: a stranger's transaction in the same block is taken for the wallet's
mutations.expect: FAIL the latest settlement is the wallet's transaction in the block where the count reached it, with its day

mutations.name: any token's transfer to the payee is read as the payment
mutations.expect: FAIL ...it paid out, the payer is read from the USDC transfer to our payee, and a customer is not ours

mutations.name: our own test wallet is not recognised
mutations.expect: FAIL a sale from our own test wallet is named ours

mutations.name: the latest sale is searched again though the count has not moved
mutations.expect: FAIL a count that has not moved costs one call: the latest is kept, a mined transaction does not change

mutations.name: a failed read throws away the last good answer
mutations.expect: FAIL a node that fails keeps the last good answer and logs the failure
